packageRules.description: Direct deps shared with the imported kure are never proposed here: launcher must not lead the kure release it imports (MVS pulls launcher up automatically, so only the 'ahead' direction needs control — see AGENTS.md § 'Shared dependencies with kure'). CI enforces this via site/scripts/check-kure-dep-sync.sh; this list mirrors that guard's current shared-direct set and must be updated together with go.mod changes that add or drop a shared direct dep — a dep missing here is still caught by the CI guard, just as a red PR instead of never being proposed. Correct sequence for these: land the kure bump, cut a kure release, bump the go-kure/kure require, take the shared dep together.
